stdout:
Build kit for "form validation"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Search matched `checkout-wizard` by name, but the idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        contact-form
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Flat single-column form mixing control types (text, pill toggles, dropdowns, long free-text) landing on one full-width submit.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template contact-form --type page <path>

name:        form-wizard
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Linear multi-step form that moves through one panel at a time, with a horizontal progress track pinned above rather than running down a rail, so every step keeps the full content width for its fields.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template form-wizard --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: checkout-wizard (@astryxdesign/core), contact-form (@astryxdesign/core), form-two-column (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        TextInputStates
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Error, warning, and success validation states with status messages.

name:        DateInputWithValidation
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Date input in all three status states: error, warning, and success.

name:        FieldStatusVariants
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: All three validation states: error, warning, and success.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 6; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        TextInput
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: TextInput collects short-form text like names, emails, or search queries.

name:        useInputStatusIcon
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Builds the on-field status affordance for a bordered input and its accessibility wiring, so every input in the family behaves the same for a given status.

name:        Field
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Field is a low-level wrapper for custom, native, or third-party controls that do not already provide field label, description, and status UI.
